scope: What the review text expresses; not verified delivery facts or seller causation.

language_policy.source_language: Portuguese (Brazil) expected; detect and preserve uncertainty
language_policy.translation: Optional comparison input only; never replaces the source text or provenance
language_policy.unsupported_or_unclear_language: preserve as unknown and route for review

mentions_delivery_problem.instructions: Does the review text express a problem with delivery, such as late delivery, non-delivery, or a delivery-related obstacle? Judge only what the reviewer says. Do not infer an objectively late delivery from the wording or treat packaging/product damage as a delivery problem unless delivery itself is explicitly implicated.

mentions_product_problem.instructions: Does the review text express a problem with the product itself, such as a defect, wrong/missing item, breakage, or poor functioning? Judge only what the reviewer says. Do not count slow delivery or outer packaging alone as a product problem.

primary_expressed_theme.instructions: Choose the single most central theme expressed in the review. If multiple themes are present, select the one most directly tied to the review's main dissatisfaction; use other_or_unclear if no option clearly fits. This describes text, not verified cause.

criteria.delivery: Explicit delivery delay, non-delivery, or delivery process complaint.
criteria.product_condition_or_function: Product defective, damaged, wrong, missing, or not working.
criteria.seller_service_or_communication: Seller/customer service, responsiveness, or communication is central.
criteria.positive_or_no_problem: Mainly positive or explicitly reports no problem.
criteria.other_or_unclear: Other topic, conflicting signals, too little text, or no defensible primary theme.

reported_experience_severity.instructions: Rate the severity of the problem the reviewer explicitly reports, not the objective operational impact and not seller fault.
criteria: No explicit problem or positive experience.
Minor dissatisfaction or inconvenience; no major loss or inability to use the item is described.
Material problem such as substantial delay, broken/wrong/missing product, or clearly unusable item; use only when supported by the wording.
reported_experience_severity.uncertainty: Keep the full probability distribution; do not treat the expected score as a physical measurement.

evaluation_contract.thresholds: No binary threshold selected yet; report probabilities and separately adjudicate any action threshold.
evaluation_contract.human_reference: Required before quality claims; assistant prelabels are not adjudicated gold labels.
forbidden_claims: A review mention proves a delivery event.
A text theme proves seller responsibility.
Jev confidence is the probability of an operational outcome.
Missing or ambiguous text means a negative label.
